specs.name: story-whole-gait-master.png
specs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Rebuild FOUR full-body STORY walking poses for the same promoted Dawn Warrior, not cut-and-pasted leg patches. Image1 top row supplies original Warrior body motion and opposing arm swing. Image2 supplies promoted costume/identity ONLY: youthful tan face, short SOLID blue hair, pale-blue shoulder/chest/knee armor, navy short split tunic/boots, silver-blue sword SHEATHED on the belt. No drawn weapon or shield in story sprites. EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows FOUR complete figures on genuinely transparent background with generous gutters, no labels, text, floor, cast shadow, checkerboard or background. TOP row = BACK-facing walk two phases. Cell1 left leg extends down under LEFT hip, right knee bends backward under RIGHT hip and heel lifts straight behind body. Cell2 right leg down under RIGHT hip, left knee bends backward under LEFT hip and heel lifts straight behind body. Raised knees and boots stay INSIDE normal pelvic width and near the other leg, toes point forward/away along vertical walking direction. Feet do NOT splay outward, no bow-legged stance, no duck feet, no diagonal sidekick. The raised boot must be a compact heel directly beneath its hip, not a sideways projecting triangular foot. Hands/forearms swing in opposition to the legs, shoulder girdle and torso have a small coherent walking twist about a FIXED waist; BOTH complete upper bodies are different natural phases, not a frozen shirt with moving detached lower legs. Sheathed sword stays on SCREEN-LEFT hip in BOTH back views, do not mirror the entire figure. BOTTOM row = RIGHT-facing side walk. Cell3 a straight-legged passing/standing phase, feet near beneath hips, one arm slightly forward and other slightly back. Cell4 a long forward stride, forward/right leg reaching right and rear leg reaching left; near forearm swings back and far forearm forward, shoulders and chest rotate gently opposite pelvis. Arms must visibly change positions and torso shape must subtly change; not just two different legs pasted below identical upper pixels. Same face identity and overall proportions. Keep HEAD center and WAIST center stationary between each pair, same physical head/body size and same foot baseline, no entire-figure up/down/left/right movement or scaling. Do NOT lock every shoulder, arm and torso pixel; internal joint motion is required. Whole connected shoulder-elbow-wrist and hip-knee-ankle anatomy. Maintain coverage of split tunic at waist; no waist seam/gap/detached body halves. Crisp small JRPG pixel art matching the existing character, compact readable pixel clusters. Palette #172638 outlines, #263c64 navy, #3976a8 blue, #a7d7e5 pale-blue armor, #e4e5df pale accents, #d7a27c skin, #a6776a skin shadow, #205b96 FLAT blue hair, #b9c5d1 silver, #4366b9 blue gem. Matte, no hair/cloth highlights, no colored glow.

specs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Correct TACTICAL horizontal movement of the SAME Dawn Warrior. Image1 is the NATIVE pose/order guide for slots2,3,6,7. It shows FACE-FORWARD lateral stepping, NOT a profile walking right/left. Image2 is promoted armor/identity ONLY. Create EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows FOUR complete figures, transparent, no labels/background/floor/shadow. ALL FOUR figures FACE THE VIEWER STRAIGHT FORWARD, frontal two eyes, centered nose, both ears and BOTH shoulders visible, chest and pelvis square to camera. NO side profile, no three-quarter sideward body, no face turned toward horizontal travel. Small fringe may shade an eye but head is unequivocally front-facing. Same youthful tan face, solid blue hair, pale-blue armor and navy split tunic/boots. Sword is silver angular blade with blue center, round blue gem guard, dark narrow grip below gem, short blue ribbon. Fist grips HANDLE BELOW guard, never blade or side bracer. Shield a navy kite with pale-blue rim, HELD IN FRONT OF THE FOREARM AND LOWER CHEST, arm bent actively supporting it; shield face fully visible toward camera and slightly OVERLAPS chest. Shield is NOT on back, not strapped behind shoulder, not hiding behind torso. TOP row = native RIGHT travel slots2 then3: sword blade diagonally UP-LEFT of head, sword fist near SCREEN-LEFT front of chest; shield on SCREEN-RIGHT FRONT of torso covering right lower chest/forearm. Cell1 feet close, knees straight, narrow passing stance. Cell2 open RIGHTWARD SIDESTEP: rightward foot slides to screen-right and other leg braces, knees/boot fronts still face viewer. BOTTOM row = native LEFT travel slots6 then7: sword blade diagonally UP-RIGHT, fist near SCREEN-RIGHT front of chest; shield on SCREEN-LEFT FRONT covering left lower chest/forearm, matching the native mirrored arrangement. Cell3 open LEFTWARD SIDESTEP, feet apart and knee braced; cell4 narrow passing/standing feet close. Frontal head/chest remain facing viewer throughout movement. Arms and shield have subtle coupled joint motion with step, remain attached and held in front, no statue upper body with unrelated lower half. HEAD center and WAIST center stable, identical physical size, fixed root and ground baseline; no whole-body bob or translate. Match original sword/shield SCREEN positions and phase ordering instead of imposing a different lateral profile or anatomical handedness scheme. Every blade tip, hilt, shield and foot complete with ample transparent margin. Crisp small JRPG pixel art matching the existing character, compact readable pixel clusters. Palette #172638 outlines, #263c64 navy, #3976a8 blue, #a7d7e5 pale-blue armor, #e4e5df pale accents, #d7a27c skin, #a6776a skin shadow, #205b96 FLAT blue hair, #b9c5d1 silver, #4366b9 blue gem. Matte, no hair/cloth highlights, no colored glow.
